title: observability: token-level cost/latency dashboards + alert tuning and tracing improvements
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: Operators and product teams need token-level breakdowns of cost and latency to spot regression and tuning opportunities; existing dashboards only surfaced aggregate P95 and total token counts which hides model/route-level regressions. This PR: 1) adds a token-level cost and latency dashboard with per-model and per-route breakdowns and heatmaps for sequence-length distributions; 2) introduces new Prometheus metrics and labels for token_cost_total, token_latency_bucketed, and token_kv_cache_hit_rate (with cardinality controls); 3) ships alert tuning for token-level SLO regressions and cost spikes with runbook links; 4) adds lightweight tracing spans around batching and cache lookup to improve root-cause analysis; 5) updates docs and console dashboard JSON for one-click import. Backwards compatibility: metrics are additive and default label cardinality is conservative to avoid label explosion. Testing: local Grafana import, unit tests for the aggregation logic, integration test exercising synthetic traffic patterns, and CI dashboard schema validation. Rollout plan: feature-flag metrics emission, enable dashboard visibility to SRE and Platform first, monitor cardinality for 48h, then enable for broader audience. Checklist: - [x] Instrument token-level metrics - [x] Dashboard JSON + samples - [x] Alert rules with tuned thresholds and dampening - [x] Tracing spans + tests - [x] Docs and runbook links - [x] Schema/CI green. Notes: alert thresholds were chosen based on last 30d baseline (ENG-4581); we opted to use rate-based alerting for cost spikes and anomaly detection for latency regressions to reduce noise.

release_notes: Added token-level cost and latency dashboard; new metrics token_cost_total and token_latency_bucketed; tuned alerts for token-level SLO regressions and cost spikes; tracing spans for batching and KV cache lookups. Default metrics emission is feature-flagged to control cardinality.
notes: This PR was driven by ENG-4581 and SRE-129. After merge we will monitor prometheus label cardinality and rollback the feature flag if high-cardinality anomalies are observed. The dashboards include pre-built variables for model_family and route to help teams migrate from aggregate to token-level views.
